lines.en: label otohapark1:
scene sky
I step outside to find that the weather isn’t all that dreadful this morning.
lines.zh: 我走出门，发现今天早晨的天气并不算太糟。

lines.en: I’m sure that will change as the day goes by because nothing good can ever persist for an entire 24 hours-
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，随着时间推移它会变糟，因为任何好事都不可能整整持续二十四小时——

lines.en: But right now, things are looking up.
lines.zh: 不过眼下，一切都在往好的方向走。

lines.en: Including myself, of course, as the sun stings my eyes for staring at it longer than it wants me to.
lines.zh: 当然也包括我自己——我盯着太阳看了比它允许的更久，于是它刺痛了我的眼睛。

lines.en: Which is any amount of time.
lines.zh: 也就是说，不管盯多久都算超时。

lines.en: But fuck it, if the sun wants to come out and say “What’s up? Here’s a little warmth,” in the middle of winter, the courteous thing for me to do is at least acknowledge him.
lines.zh: 可管他呢，如果太阳想在隆冬时节跑出来跟我说一句“怎么样？给你点温暖吧”，那我出于礼貌，至少也该回应它一下。

lines.en: Or her.
lines.zh: 或者她。

lines.en: Or they.
lines.zh: 或者他们。

lines.en: The sun can be whatever gender it wants to be and I won’t judge it for its decision.
lines.zh: 太阳想当什么性别都行，我不会对它的选择评头论足。

lines.en: I’m a good guy.
lines.zh: 我是个好人。

lines.en: scene otohapark1
Oh right.
lines.zh: 哦对了。

lines.en: Otoha said something about coming to the park in the mornings.
lines.zh: Otoha 提过一句，说她早上会来公园。

lines.en: I guess it’s possible that I came here with that in mind, but...
lines.zh: 我想，我来这儿或许确实存着这个念头，不过……

lines.en: Well, I feel like I somehow would have wound up here regardless of whether or not she’d told me that.
lines.zh: 嗯，我觉得不管她告没告诉我，我大概总会走到这儿来。

lines.en: It’s just that kind of day.
lines.zh: 今天就是这么个日子。

lines.en: : Otoha? More like Yo-toha.
lines.zh: : Otoha？该叫 Yo-toha 才对。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么样啊？

lines.en: scene otohapark2
: Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: : Did you really just greet me with “Yo-toha?”
lines.zh: : 你刚才真的用“Yo-toha”跟我打招呼了吗？

lines.en: : No. That never happened.
lines.zh: : 没有。没这回事。

lines.en: scene otohapark3
: Yeah, I didn’t think so either. That would have been super lame.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也觉得没有。那也太土了。

lines.en: : Almost as lame as hanging out in the park by yourself when there are tons of other girls who’d gladly come with you.
lines.zh: : 跟你一个人待在公园里差不多土——明明有一大堆女孩会很乐意陪你来。

lines.en: scene otohapark4
: Well, let’s see...
lines.zh: : 嗯，让我想想……

lines.en: : Nodoka hates mornings, Noriko hates mornings, and Rin works mornings.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 讨厌早上，Noriko 讨厌早上，Rin 早上要打工。

lines.en: : That’s pretty much everybody I’m close with so that leaves...me, myself and I.
lines.zh: : 跟我亲近的人基本就这些了，所以剩下的……就是我自己了。

lines.en: : It’s cool, though. I like having alone time and coming here by myself is a good way to relax.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。我喜欢独处，一个人来这儿是放松的好办法。

lines.en: : Especially since it’s actually pretty nice out today.
lines.zh: : 尤其是今天外面其实挺舒服的。

lines.en: : For now. I’m sure it’ll start snowing in like two hours or something.
lines.zh: : 暂时而已。我敢肯定再过个两小时就会下起雪来。

lines.en: : Kumon-mi’s weather patterns seem to fluctuate very dramatically from day to day.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 的天气模式似乎一天一个样，波动得厉害。

lines.en: scene otohapark2
: Guess we better make the best of it while we can then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我们最好趁现在好好享受一下，对吧？

lines.en: : Also, the weather really only gets weird during the winter. Every day in the summer is like, just hot and gross and stuff.
lines.zh: : 而且天气怪成这样其实只在冬天。夏天的每一天嘛，就是又热又黏之类的。

lines.en: : Yup. That’s a Japanese summer for you.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这就是日本的夏天。

lines.en: : Kinda pumped for the seasons to change again, honestly.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还挺期待季节再变换一次的。

lines.en: : Sure, it might get all humid and whatnot, but it’s a lot easier playing guitar with warm hands than cold ones.
lines.zh: : 虽说可能会变得很潮湿什么的，但手暖的时候弹吉他可比手冷的时候容易多了。

lines.en: : A lot less people come out to watch street performers in the winter too.
lines.zh: : 而且冬天出来看街头艺人的人也少得多。

lines.en: : Like, just take a look around you. We’re the only two people here and it's not even cold right now.
lines.zh: : 就说你往四周看看吧。这儿只有我们两个人，可现在甚至都还不冷。

lines.en: : Then I suppose you’ll just have to serenade me alone.
lines.zh: : 那看来你只能单独为我弹一曲了。

lines.en: scene otohapark5
: Not only would that make me extremely uncomfortable, but I don’t even have my guitar with me.
lines.zh: : 且不说那样会让我非常不自在，我连吉他都没带。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be the first time I’ve had to figure out how to deal with just one dude watching me play while everyone passes by but...it’s definitely not something I want to get used to.
lines.zh: : 我得应付「所有人都匆匆走过、只剩一个男的在看我弹」这种场面，也不是第一次了，不过……这绝对不是我想习惯的事。

lines.en: : Sure, but at least there would be a historically lower probability of him making a move on you than another girl.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，但至少从概率上讲，他对你出手的可能性比另一个女孩要低。

lines.en: scene otohapark6
: Wait, yeah. That’s a good point.
lines.zh: : 等等，对啊。这话说得有道理。

lines.en: : I guess it's not creepy at all when you put it like that.
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，好像一点都不瘆人了。

lines.en: : No. It's definitely creepy.
lines.zh: : 不。那绝对很瘆人。

lines.en: : Don’t let my bad advice lure you into a false sense of security unless I’m going to personally benefit from it.
lines.zh: : 别让我那些烂建议把你哄进虚假的安全感里——除非我能从中捞到好处。

lines.en: scene otohapark7
: Roger.
lines.zh: : 收到。

lines.en: : Then, if you ever show up to find me playing by myself, just keep on walking and pretend you never even saw me.
lines.zh: : 那以后你要是撞见我一个人在弹，就继续往前走，假装压根没看见我。

lines.en: : Only after dropping a 1,000 yen note in my guitar case, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，得先往我琴盒里丢一张一千日元的钞票。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to give you money {i}and{/i} pretend I don’t see you at the same time?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么才既能把钱给你，{i}又{/i}假装没看见你？

lines.en: : Maybe just accidentally drop it in one very specific location?
lines.zh: : 也许就“不小心”把钱掉在一个非常特定的位置？

lines.en: : I don’t know man, you do you. A girl’s gotta earn some cash one way or another.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道啊，老兄，你看着办吧。一个姑娘总得想办法挣点钱。

lines.en: : And without a job, I’ve gotta rely on kind souls like you.
lines.zh: : 又没有工作，我就只能指望你这样的好心人了。

lines.en: : Don’t call me a kind soul when I haven’t even tipped you yet.
lines.zh: : 在我还没给你小费之前，别叫我好心人。

lines.en: scene otohapark8
: I’m just thanking you in advance since I know you’ll take good care of me.
lines.zh: : 我只是提前谢你，因为我知道你会好好照顾我的。

lines.en: : Well if you keep entrapping people like this, I’m sure you’ll be absolutely rolling in money in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 你要是继续这样给人下套，我敢说你很快就会赚得盆满钵满。

lines.en: scene otohapark2
: Sure hope so.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此吧。

lines.en: : There would be some days in my old park where I’d be there for like ten hours and not even make 5,000 in total.
lines.zh: : 在我以前那个公园，有时候我在那儿待上十个小时，总共都赚不到五千。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like you should have found a different park.
lines.zh: : 听起来你应该换个公园才对。

lines.en: : I don’t think it was the park’s fault. And I don’t want to sound cocky, but I don’t think it was mine either.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是公园的问题。我也不想显得狂妄，但我觉得也不是我的问题。

lines.en: : It’s a lot busier on that side of town than this one. People just don’t really like giving out their money to street performers for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 镇上那一头比这头热闹得多。可不知道为什么，人们就是不太愿意把钱给街头艺人。

lines.en: : Maybe if I grew up back when my mom did and people actually carried around cash, I would have had an easier time.
lines.zh: : 要是我生在我妈那个年代，大家身上还真带着现金，我可能就好过多了。

lines.en: : She always made it sound so simple.
lines.zh: : 她总把这事说得特别简单。

lines.en: : Your mother was a performer too?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈以前也是艺人？

lines.en: : Once upon a time, yeah. She was in some girl band that toured Japan a few times but never really made it out of the country.
lines.zh: : 很久以前，是的。她待过一个女子乐队，在日本巡演过几次，但始终没能走出国门。

lines.en: : Now she’s just a normal mom with a normal husband and a decently normal daughter.
lines.zh: : 现在她就是个普通的妈妈，有个普通的丈夫，还有个还算普通的女儿。

lines.en: : Didn’t you say something the other day about how she didn’t want you to be a musician, though?
lines.zh: : 可你前几天不是说过，她不想让你当音乐人吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but like, I think it’s one of those things where you regret your own experiences and don’t want someone you care about to do the same thing or whatever.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过我觉得这就是那种——自己后悔经历过的事，就不想让在乎的人再走一遍，之类的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I don’t really get how old people think.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我实在搞不懂上了年纪的人是怎么想的。

lines.en: : Do you want to like...sit down, by the way?
lines.zh: : 对了，你想……坐下来吗？

lines.en: : It feels kind of weird carrying on an entire conversation with you just looming over me like some sort of statue.
lines.zh: : 你像座雕像似的杵在我旁边，就这么把一整段对话聊完，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, sure.
lines.zh: : 哦。好，当然。

lines.en: scene otohapark9
Otoha slides over on the bench to make room for me, wrapping her arms around her legs in what could be interpreted as either a defensive stance or...just a comfortable one, I guess.
lines.zh: Otoha 在长椅上挪了挪给我腾出位置，双臂环住双腿——这既可以理解成一种防备的姿态，也可以……就只是一个舒服的姿势吧。

lines.en: It’s strange how something as simple as folding your limbs a certain way can mean two completely different things.
lines.zh: 仅仅是把手脚按某种方式叠起来这么简单的事，却能表达出两种截然不同的意思，真是奇怪。

lines.en: : So, speaking of how old people think-
lines.zh: : 那么，说到上了年纪的人是怎么想的——

lines.en: : Don’t do it, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 别往下说了，Otoha。

lines.en: : Don’t do what?
lines.zh: : 别干什么？

lines.en: : Don’t call me old.
lines.zh: : 别说我老。

lines.en: : Okay, I won’t.
lines.zh: : 好，我不说。

lines.en: : You’re definitely not young, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你绝对算不上年轻。

lines.en: : Saying that is just as bad...
lines.zh: : 这么说一样很过分……

lines.en: : You’re...old by comparison?
lines.zh: : 你……相对来说比较老？

lines.en: : I mean...that’s better. But...
lines.zh: : 我是说……这好一点了。不过……

lines.en: scene otohapark10
: I’m just kidding, Sensei. Well...kind of.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的，Sensei。嗯……也不全是。

lines.en: : You might {i}be{/i} old, but you act kind of like a...cool senpai or something.
lines.zh: : 你{i}也许{/i}是老了，但你表现得像个……挺酷的前辈之类的。

lines.en: : Not like the[school] prince or anything, but the broody guy that a really specific clique of girls all pine over.
lines.zh: : 不是那种[school]王子什么的，而是某一小撮特定女生都会暗恋的那种阴郁家伙。

lines.en: : Right. But that’s only because the[school] prince position was taken over by you once you transferred in.
lines.zh: : 对。不过那只是因为你转学过来之后，[school]王子的位子就被你抢走了。

lines.en: scene otohapark11
: That’s only true based on statistics! I’m clearly not princely at all!
lines.zh: : 那只是统计意义上的！我明显一点都不像王子！

lines.en: : Princess, then?
lines.zh: : 那公主呢？

lines.en: : That’s just as embarrassing!
lines.zh: : 那也一样丢人！

lines.en: : How do I become the dark and broody type like you?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么才能变成你那种阴郁又深沉的类型？

lines.en: : Easy. Just give up on everything you’ve ever loved and surrender yourself to your impending demise.
lines.zh: : 简单。放弃你曾经爱过的一切，然后把自己交给即将到来的毁灭。

lines.en: scene otohapark12
: Woah. So lame.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。好逊。

lines.en: scene otohapark13
: Pfft...{i}Just give up on everything you’ve ever loved. My name is Sensei and I’m the coolest guy in Kumon-mi.{/i}
lines.zh: : 噗……{i}放弃你曾经爱过的一切。我叫 Sensei，是 Kumon-mi 最酷的男人。{/i}

lines.en: : You are making a mockery of my flawlessly flawed personality, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 你这是在嘲弄我那完美无缺的残缺人格，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohapark14
: Only cause you’re making it so easy. You’ll never get a girlfriend if you keep acting like that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谁让你这么好嘲弄呢。你再这样下去，永远都交不到女朋友的，Sensei。

lines.en: : I already told you I don’t want a girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我不想要女朋友。

lines.en: : Sure, but you’ll want one eventually.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你总有一天会想要的。

lines.en: : Like, you won’t just...go the rest of your life without one, right?
lines.zh: : 就是说，你不会……就这样一辈子不找吧？

lines.en: : Have you ever even had an actual girlfriend before?
lines.zh: : 你以前到底有没有过真正的女朋友？

lines.en: : Yup. Just some idol chick. She’s famous now.
lines.zh: : 有啊。不过是个偶像妹子。她现在很有名。

lines.en: : Right, right. You dated a famous idol cause you’re the coolest guy in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 对对。你跟一个著名偶像交往过，因为你是 Kumon-mi 最酷的男人。

lines.en: : Which one? Anyone I would be familiar with?
lines.zh: : 哪一个？是我会认识的那种吗？

lines.en: : Very much so.
lines.zh: : 非常认识。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Who? Let’s see if I-
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？谁啊？让我看看我——

lines.en: : I dated your vocal coach for five years.
lines.zh: : 我跟你声乐老师交往了五年。

lines.en: : Who...do you think my vocal coach is?
lines.zh: : 你……以为我的声乐老师是谁？

lines.en: : I don’t...remember telling anyone about that.
lines.zh: : 我不……记得跟谁说过这事。

lines.en: : Niki Nakayama.
lines.zh: : Niki Nakayama。

lines.en: : She’s actually the one who told me she was coaching you. I’ve known for a little while now.
lines.zh: : 其实是她自己告诉我她在教你的。我知道有一阵子了。

lines.en: : And you just...decided not to say anything about it?
lines.zh: : 然后你就……决定一个字都不提？

lines.en: : It never really came up in conversation.
lines.zh: : 聊天的时候真没机会提到。

lines.en: : I don’t believe you.
lines.zh: : 我不信你。

lines.en: : This is clearly a coordinated prank. Noriko probably heard about it from Niki and then...planned this with you or something.
lines.zh: : 这明显是串通好的恶作剧。Noriko 大概是从 Niki 那儿听说的，然后……跟你一起策划了这出，之类的。

lines.en: : Call her.
lines.zh: : 打给她。

lines.en: : Like...right now?
lines.zh: : 就……现在？

lines.en: : Right now.
lines.zh: : 就现在。

lines.en: : But...she’s probably busy...
lines.zh: : 可……她大概在忙……

lines.en: : Call her and say nothing but “Sausage fest.”
lines.zh: : 打给她，别的什么都别说，只说“香肠派对”。

lines.en: : I’m not going to call Niki and say “Sausage fest.” What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 我不会打给 Niki 说“香肠派对”的。那到底什么意思啊？

lines.en: : It’s her favorite dish and an inseparable bond the two of us share.
lines.zh: : 那是她最爱的一道菜，也是我俩之间不可分割的纽带。

lines.en: : Nah. This is a joke. I’m not falling for it.
lines.zh: : 不。这是个玩笑。我才不上当。

lines.en: : Why? Don’t think I’m cool enough?
lines.zh: : 为什么？觉得我还不够酷？

lines.en: : Not that. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 不是那个。只是……

lines.en: : She’s...an adult.
lines.zh: : 她是……个成年人。

lines.en: : Okay. That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 好吧。这倒也是。

lines.en: scene otohapark15
: B-Besides! She’s said all kinds of messed up stuff about her ex before and you don’t really seem like that kind of guy!
lines.zh: : 再、再说！她以前说过她前任一大堆乱七八糟的事，你可不太像那种人！

lines.en: : Like yeah you’re...just as weird and stoic as she described, but I highly doubt you’d ever just up and ghost on someone who loves you as much as she loved him!
lines.zh: : 是啊，你……确实跟她描述的一样古怪又面无表情，但我非常怀疑你会突然人间蒸发，抛下一个像她爱他那样爱你的人！

lines.en: : Like...don’t mention this to anyone, but she even said some stuff about how she almost killed herself this one time and like...
lines.zh: : 比如……这话别跟别人说，她甚至说过有一次她差点自杀什么的，然后……

lines.en: : There’s no way...that person is...
lines.zh: : 不可能吧……那个人是……

lines.en: scene otohapark16
: It totally was you...wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那个人就是你……对吧？

lines.en: : I’m telling you, there are only two words you need to say to her that would answer every question you have right now.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说了，你只要对她说两个字，就能回答你现在所有的疑问。

lines.en: : I’m not going to call Niki and say “Sausage fest.”
lines.zh: : 我不会打给 Niki 说“香肠派对”的。

lines.en: scene otohapark17
: You know, I really wish I didn’t have to keep doing this.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我真希望自己不用一直这么干。

lines.en: : Who...are you calling?
lines.zh: : 你在……打给谁？

lines.en: I tap on Niki’s name and set my phone to speaker mode so Otoha can listen to her world shatter into a million pieces.
lines.zh: 我点开 Niki 的名字，把手机调成免提，好让 Otoha 亲耳听着她的世界碎成千万片。

lines.en: This will show her how cool I am.
lines.zh: 这下她总该知道我有多酷了。

lines.en: : Yeah? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 喂？怎么了？

lines.en: scene otohapark18
: Sausage fest.
lines.zh: : 香肠派对。

lines.en: : What, like right now?
lines.zh: : 什么，就现在吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. I should have a little time before my lesson. I just have to get dressed.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。上课前我应该还有点时间。我得先穿好衣服。

lines.en: : Actually, forget it. I changed my mind.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。我改主意了。

lines.en: : Already?...
lines.zh: : 这就改了？……

lines.en: : Yup.
: Well you better have a good excuse because I’m already halfway through taking my pajamas-
lines.zh: : 那你最好有个像样的理由，因为我睡衣都已经脱了一半——

lines.en: : I’m actually with Otoha right now.
lines.zh: : 其实我现在跟 Otoha 在一起。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Hi, Niki...
lines.zh: : 你好啊，Niki……

lines.en: : [nikitemp]...
lines.zh: : [nikitemp]……

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: : {i}Why{/i} are you with Otoha right now?
lines.zh: : {i}为什么{/i}你现在跟 Otoha 在一起？

lines.en: scene otohapark19
: Your name is [nikitemp]?
lines.zh: : 你的名字是[nikitemp]？

lines.en: : We’re on a date. I was actually just calling you to brag about it.
lines.zh: : 我们在约会。其实我打给你就是为了显摆一下。

lines.en: : Oh, no you are not! Put her on the phone right now!
lines.zh: : 哦，你才不是！马上让她接电话！

lines.en: : Sorry. About to do the sex to each other. Talk to you later.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我们马上要做爱了。回头再聊。

lines.en: scene otohapark20
: HOLD ON ONE SECOND, YOU FUCKING-
lines.zh: : 等一下，你这个死——

lines.en: I hang up on Niki because I wear the pants in this relationship.
lines.zh: 我挂了 Niki 的电话，因为在这段关系里，是我说了算。

lines.en: I lied about wishing I didn’t have to do this. It’s actually really fun.
lines.zh: 我说希望不用一直这么干是骗人的。其实挺好玩的。

lines.en: : Why would you tell her that?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要跟她说那种话？！

lines.en: : Niki and I have a good working relationship and the last thing I want is for her to think I’m sleeping with her ex!
lines.zh: : 我和 Niki 的合作关系很好，我最不想的就是让她以为我在跟她前任上床！

lines.en: : This is going to be so awkward to have to explain!
lines.zh: : 这下我要解释起来得多尴尬啊！

lines.en: : You brought this on yourself for not believing me.
lines.zh: : 谁让你不信我，自找的。

lines.en: : Don’t pin that on me! No one would ever believe something like that!
lines.zh: : 别赖到我头上！换成谁都不会相信这种事！

lines.en: : Then each and every one of them shall feel my wrath.
lines.zh: : 那他们每一个人，都得领教我的怒火。

lines.en: : Now, back to our date.
lines.zh: : 好了，回到我们的约会。

lines.en: : No way! I’m supposed to meet her in less than two hours and now I have to call her and explain myself!
lines.zh: : 想得美！我不到两小时后就要去见她了，现在还得打电话跟她解释！

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Well, it was a nice and productive morning we had together, Otoha. Enjoy your vocal lesson.
lines.zh: : 那我们今早相处得挺愉快、也挺有成果的，Otoha。好好享受你的声乐课吧。

lines.en: : I’ll be lucky if I live through it at this rate! You know what she’s like when she gets mad!
lines.zh: : 照这样下去，我能活着上完课就算走运了！你知道她生气起来是什么样子！

lines.en: : You’re right. The only way out at this point is for us to kill ourselves together.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。事到如今，唯一的出路就是我们俩一起自杀。

lines.en: : Sensei! I’m being serious! Don’t mess this up for me!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我是认真的！别把我的事搞砸了！

lines.en: scene otohapark21
: ...What?
: I’m just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I’m just glad you at least got to experience true freedom for a few days before the end...
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴，至少在末日之前，你还能体验几天真正的自由……

lines.en: scene black
Otoha’s phone goes off before she even has a chance to hop off of the bench.
lines.zh: Otoha 还没来得及从长椅上跳下来，她的手机就响了。

lines.en: Without even saying goodbye to me, she answers it and frantically tries to explain that there was no date and that I was simply just trying to prove something.
lines.zh: 她连再见都没跟我说就接了起来，手忙脚乱地解释说根本没有约会，我只是想证明什么罢了。

lines.en: Trying isn’t accurate anymore, though, as I’m clearly drowning in success right now.
lines.zh: 不过「想证明」已经不准确了，因为此刻我显然已经淹没在成功之中。

lines.en: Maybe I should consider putting Niki on speed dial if I’m going to have to keep using her like this?
lines.zh: 如果还要这样一直利用 Niki，也许我该考虑把她设成快速拨号？

lines.en: $ otoha_love += 1
$ otohapark1 = True
{i}Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
